gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule E - Rental Properties (Form 1098 treated as personal)
gotchas.title: 1098 for the duplex address autoflows to Schedule A
gotchas.trap: Put the $9,860 rental mortgage interest (and $5,420 escrow taxes) on Schedule A -> itemize ($41,825) and show a duplex profit.
gotchas.correct_treatment: 1098 box 8 = rental address (box 7 'No'): interest and escrowed taxes are Schedule E expenses of the duplex. Correct itemized total $26,545 < standard $31,500 -> standard deduction; duplex shows a ($3,207) loss (suspended).
gotchas.impact: Deduction type flips; passive income/loss misstated

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule E - capitalization of repairs vs improvements; de minimis election
gotchas.title: Roof, water heater, window
gotchas.trap: Expense the $14,000 roof as a repair (ledger coded it 'Repairs'), or capitalize everything.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Roof: full tear-off replacement = restoration of a building system -> capitalize, 27.5-yr SL mid-month from 06/2025 ($276 for 2025); small-taxpayer safe harbor fails (> 2% of UBB). Water heater $1,900: de minimis safe harbor (<= $2,500 per invoice) with the election statement attached. Window $450: repair.
gotchas.impact: Sch E line 14 overstated $14,000 (loss suspended anyway, but basis/carryforward wrong)

gotchas.title: Cabin rented 62 days, used personally 21 days
gotchas.trap: Report the cabin as a regular rental with a full-year loss (or count only 18 personal days, excluding the brother's free stay).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Use by a family member (brother) is personal use even if he paid nothing; the deck-repair weekend is not personal use. 21 personal days > 14 and > 10% of 62 -> the cabin is a residence: expenses allocated 62/83 and limited to rental income (Worksheet 5-1). Net $0; carry forward operating $260 + depreciation $4,244; personal share of interest/taxes to Sch A worksheet.

gotchas.procedure_section: General Return Prep Notes - blank organizer line with PY amount (suspended passive loss)
gotchas.title: PY suspended loss not on the organizer
gotchas.trap: Start Form 8582 at zero - the $6,200 carryforward is lost.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Pull the $6,200 unallowed loss from the PY return/PERM. MAGI $171,682 > $150k -> $25k special allowance fully phased out; 2025 loss ($3,207) also suspended -> carry $9,407 to 2026.

gotchas.title: AOTC in the MAGI phase-out; 18-year-old dependent
gotchas.trap: Claim the full $2,500 AOTC on the $18,400 box 1 (ignoring the scholarship) and a $2,200 CTC for Emma.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Qualified expenses = 18,400 - 6,000 scholarship = $12,400 (>= $4,000 -> $2,500 tentative). MAGI $171,682 is in the $160k-$180k range -> allowed $1,040 ($416 refundable on line 29). Emma is 18 -> $500 ODC, Connor $2,200 CTC.

gotchas.title: Lender escrow statement repeats the 1098 interest and taxes
gotchas.trap: Autoflow the escrow year-end summary as a second 1098 -> duplex interest/taxes doubled.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Escrow statement is support only; use Form 1098 once (Sch E line 12 9,860; line 16 5,420).

gotchas.title: PA-40 prepared from federal numbers
gotchas.trap: Use federal wages (box 1) and net the rental loss against compensation.
gotchas.correct_treatment: PA compensation = W-2 box 16 $189,300 (401(k)/403(b) deferrals are PA-taxable). The rents class is a loss and cannot offset other classes (no carryforward). PA tax 3.07% x $189,682 = $5,823; local EIT final return filed separately.

software_exceptions.title: Duplex Form 1098 (box 8 = rental address) AutoFlowed to Schedule A; escrow summary imported as a second 1098
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: AutoFlow treats every Form 1098 as home mortgage interest: the duplex 1098 ($9,860 interest; $5,420 escrowed taxes) went to Schedule A, flipping the return to itemized ($41,825) and overstating the duplex result. The lender's escrow year-end summary was imported as another 1098 (duplicate).
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Delete the Schedule A 1098 entries for the duplex and the escrow-summary record. Rental (Schedule E) Property A: mortgage interest $9,860 (line 12), taxes $5,420 (line 16). Itemized $26,545 < standard $31,500 -> standard.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: If the 1098 is entered on the itemized-deduction mortgage screen it is deducted on Schedule A; ProConnect does not read box 8.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Enter the interest and taxes on the Rental & Royalty Income (Schedule E) screen for the duplex, not on the Schedule A mortgage interest screen (screen names per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.proconnect_reference: Screen names per current release - verify
software_exceptions.procedure_section: Schedule E - Rental Properties (Form 1098 treated as personal)
software_exceptions.notes: Box 7 'No' (not the borrower's residence) and box 8 address are the tells.

software_exceptions.title: Roof coded 'Repairs' in the client ledger; water heater de minimis; window repair
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Rental expenses are keyed from the client's ledger by category, so the $14,000 full roof replacement lands on Schedule E line 14 as a repair. Axcess cannot distinguish a restoration of a building system from a repair, and applies the de minimis safe harbor only if the election is made.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Depreciation (Form 4562) for Property A: add 'Roof replacement' 06/2025, $14,000, residential rental 27.5-yr SL mid-month -> $276. Remove it from repairs. Water heater $1,900 on line 19 with the Reg. 1.263(a)-1(f) election statement (General > Elections / statement - verify); window $450 stays a repair. Small-taxpayer safe harbor not available (> 2% of $265,000 UBB).
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - expenses entered as repairs are deducted; capitalization is a preparer determination.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Add the roof as a residential rental asset on the property's depreciation screen (27.5-yr, 06/2025); generate the de minimis election statement (screen/field per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.procedure_section: Schedule E - capitalization of repairs vs improvements; de minimis election
software_exceptions.notes: Loss is suspended either way, but the basis and the suspended-loss carryforward would be wrong.

software_exceptions.title: Form 8582: PY unallowed loss $6,200 not on the organizer; $25,000 allowance fully phased out
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Axcess releases or suspends only the prior-year unallowed loss present on the activity's carryover input. The organizer was silent; if the 2024 carryover is not on the duplex activity (e.g., the property is re-keyed as a new activity from the scanned ledger) the $6,200 is silently lost.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Rental (Schedule E) Property A > passive carryover input: prior-year unallowed loss (regular) $6,200 per the 2024 Form 8582 / PERM (verify AMT carryover - same amount, no AMT preferences). MAGI $171,682 > $150,000 -> special allowance $0; 2025 loss ($3,207) also suspended -> $9,407 to 2026.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - ProConnect uses the prior-year unallowed losses entered on the rental's Passive Losses tab.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Rental & Royalty Income > Passive Losses tab: prior-year unallowed losses - Regular $6,200 and AMT $6,200 (enter both). Form 8582 generates automatically (or force: 1 = when applicable, 2 = force).
software_exceptions.proconnect_reference: Intuit help: 'How to generate Form 8582 in ProConnect Tax'; community thread on prior years' unallowed losses
software_exceptions.procedure_section: General Return Prep Notes - blank organizer line with PY amount (suspended passive loss)
software_exceptions.notes: The 9,407 carryforward is not listed in the answer key's carryforwards_to_2026 block (only in the gotchas/notes).

software_exceptions.title: Cabin - sec. 280A residence: personal days must include the brother's free stay
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Axcess's vacation-home limitation uses the personal-use and rental days entered. The draft keyed 18 personal days (family only) - under 18 days the cabin is still a residence (18 > 14), but the allocation % and the carryovers change; the first draft went further and keyed the cabin as a regular rental with a ~$7,000 loss. The software cannot know Pat's free nights are personal use or that the deck weekend was repair work.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Rental (Schedule E) Property B: type 1 (single family / vacation), fair rental days 62, personal use days 21 (18 family + 3 brother; 10/11-10/12 repair weekend excluded). IRS method 62/83 = 74.70%; rental income limit applies (Pub. 527 Worksheet 5-1): interest $6,200 + taxes $2,480 + direct $2,430 -> operating $3,770 of $4,030 -> depreciation $0 of $4,244. Net $0; carry forward operating $260 + depreciation $4,244. Personal share of interest $2,100 / taxes $840 to the Schedule A worksheet.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - the vacation home limitation is computed from the days entered on the rental screen.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Rental & Royalty Income: days rented at fair rental 62; personal use days 21; vacation home limitation applies (IRS method). Check the carryover of operating expenses and depreciation (screen/field per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.notes: Bolton method (interest/taxes x 62/365) would free more operating expense; IRS method used per firm procedure - no 2025 tax difference (standard deduction). Not a passive activity (sec. 469(j)(10)) - no 8582 for the cabin.

software_exceptions.title: PA-40: compensation from W-2 box 16 (401k/403b taxable) and rents loss stays in its class
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: The draft PA return used federal W-2 box 1 as PA compensation and netted the rents-class loss against wages. PA compensation must come from box 16 (elective deferrals are PA-taxable); if box 16 is blank or copied from box 1 on the W-2 input, the PA return understates compensation with no diagnostic.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: W-2 inputs: PA state wages (box 16) $189,300 combined. PA rents class: duplex ($3,207) + cabin (PA - no sec. 280A limit assumed) = loss ($7,711) - not netted against compensation (PA Schedule E / class-netting input - verify). PA taxable income $189,682 x 3.07% = $5,823; withheld $5,812 -> due $11.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - PA compensation follows the state wages entered on the W-2 screen.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: W-2 screen: PA state wages = box 16; PA return rents class shows the loss with no offset (screen/field per current release - verify).
